## Data source

This project uses adult participant data from the **2017–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)**, conducted by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The analysis joins the [demographics](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/DEMO_J.htm), [depression screener](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/DPQ_J.htm), and [high-sensitivity C-reactive protein](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/HSCRP_J.htm) records. See [How We Measured It](methods.html) for the selection rules, measures, and limitations.
